per_rule.rule: S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty.
S_N must not be null.
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Account_No must match the Account_No stored in Acc_Info_dirty for the same customer.
Account_No must not be null.
Account_No must be stored as a 4-digit account number string.
Name must not be null.
Name should follow the dominant title-like casing convention; fully uppercase or fully lowercase names should be flagged for review.
Malay and Indian name particles must be consistent with Gender: 'Bin' or 's/o' indicate Male, while 'Binte' or 'd/o' indicate Female.
ID_No must not be null.
ID_No must follow the dominant format of one uppercase letter, followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter.
Race must use the canonical observed categories: Chinese, Malay, or Indian.
Gender must use the canonical values Male or Female.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value.
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive.
Age below 13 should be flagged as potentially unrealistic for this customer service dataset.
Contact_No must not be null.
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number using only allowed phone characters and containing either a local 8-digit number or the Singapore country code 65 plus an 8-digit local number.
Email must match the standard email structure with exactly one '@' and no whitespace.
Country must use the approved canonical value 'Singapore'.
Street_Name must not be null.
Street_Name should follow the dominant title-case style; fully uppercase street names should be flagged for review.
Postal_Code must be stored as a digit-only string of 5 or 6 characters.
If Country is Singapore, Postal_Code should be a 6-digit numeric string.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Name should match the customer name held in Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name after normalizing case and spacing differences.
For each shared S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No must match the ID stored in Acc_Info_dirty for the same customer.
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
